message.content:
Using \( \log(x^{3}) = 3\log(x) \), the integral is

\[
\int -3\log(x^{3})\,dx = -9\int \log(x)\,dx
\]

Since

\[
\int \log(x)\,dx = x\log(x) - x
\]

we get

\[
-9\bigl(x\log(x)-x\bigr)+C = -9*x*log(x) + 9*x + C
\]

<answer>-9*x*log(x) + 9*x + C</answer>
